[*Pokémon*](Pok%C3%A9mon_(video_game_series) "Pokémon (video game series)") (originally "*Pocket Monsters*") is a [series](Video_game_franchise "Video game franchise") of [role-playing](Role-playing_video_game "Role-playing video game") [video games](Video_game "Video game") developed by [Game Freak](Game_Freak "Game Freak") and published by <Nintendo> and [The Pokémon Company](The_Pok%C3%A9mon_Company "The Pokémon Company"). Over the years, a number of spin-off games based on the series have also been developed by multiple companies. While the main series consists of RPGs, spin-off games encompass other genres, such as [action role-playing](Action_role-playing_game "Action role-playing game"), [puzzle](Puzzle_video_game "Puzzle video game"), [fighting](Fighting_game "Fighting game"), and [digital pet](Digital_pet "Digital pet") games. Most *Pokémon* video games have been developed exclusively for Nintendo [handhelds](Handheld_game_console "Handheld game console"), [video game consoles](Video_game_console "Video game console"), dating from the [Game Boy](Game_Boy "Game Boy") to the [current generation of video game consoles](Ninth_generation_of_video_game_consoles "Ninth generation of video game consoles").
